run_profile_analyzer: run the profile analyzer script to process latency trace files and output formatted profiling tables
review_CallStackBuilder: review the CallStackBuilder class that parses JSON trace lines and builds call stack scopes using a stack-based approach
review_CallStack: review the CallStack class that aggregates identical call stacks by signature and accumulates timing data across occurrences
review_ScopeBuilder: review the ScopeBuilder class that tracks individual scope entries and computes self time and child timing metrics
summarize_percentile: summarize the percentile function that computes interpolated percentile values from a sorted list of numbers
